coach.morning_action: Open a water cycle: 16 oz water + 1 stick. Recheck in 25 min.
coach.morning_explanation: Overnight recovery window: {{oz}} oz. Reset your baseline before training.
coach.peak_action: Maintain. Sip 8 oz of water before your next session.
coach.peak_explanation: Flow state active. Add a stick if heat or output rises.
coach.balanced_action: Sip 12 oz of water now. Recheck in 45 min.
coach.balanced_explanation: Recovery stable. Stay ahead of your next water cycle.
coach.recovering_action: Open a water cycle: 16 oz water + 1 stick. Recheck in 20 min.
coach.recovering_explanation: Recovery window opening. A water cycle now keeps you in flow.
coach.depleted_action: Recovery needed: 20 oz water + 2 sticks. Recheck in 10 min.
coach.depleted_explanation: Deep recovery window. Electrolytes will restore your balance.
coach.context_heat_high: Heat is opening your recovery window faster. Add 20% to your intake.
coach.context_heat_elevated: Heat load elevated. Stay ahead of your next water cycle.
coach.context_long_gap: {{minutes}} min since your last sip. Recovery window opening.
coach.consequence_drop: Without action: score drifts to {{projected}} in {{minutes}} min.
coach.consequence_critical: Recovery window may stay open without correction.
coach.social_drink_water_action: Sip 12 ounces of water now. Then pace your next drink for 30 minutes.
coach.social_drink_water_explanation: Hydration after a drink protects tomorrow. One glass now resets the curve.
coach.social_take_rtd_action: Take 1 RTD now. Sip 16 ounces of water before the next round.
coach.social_take_rtd_explanation: Recovery window opening ({{score}}/100). Electrolytes now make morning easier.
coach.social_slow_intake_action: Sip water between drinks. You're at {{count}} so far — pace from here.
coach.social_slow_intake_explanation: Spacing drinks to 30+ minutes keeps the rhythm steady and the morning clean.
coach.social_recovery_action: Sip 20 ounces of water before sleep.
coach.social_recovery_explanation: Recovery window is open. Two units of fluid + electrolytes now is the difference.
coach.social_stop_action: Pause alcohol. Recovery window is open.
coach.social_stop_explanation: You're in a high-impact window. Switch to water and begin your recovery.
coach.social_do_not_drive_action: Please don't drive. Use a rideshare or call a friend.
coach.social_do_not_drive_explanation: Reaction time and judgment are significantly reduced. A ride is the safer next move.

social.title: SOCIAL MODE
social.intro_body: Social Mode keeps your hydration on track in real time. Pick what you're drinking and we'll handle the rest — pacing, water reminders, and a recovery plan.
social.recovery_body: You stopped drinking recently. The next 8 hours decide how you'll feel in the morning.
social.hydration_prompt: Did you drink water or an RTD after that last one?
social.recovery_step_water: Drink 20 ounces of water before bed.
social.safety_use_rideshare: Plan a ride before your next drink.
social.safety_stop_drinking: Stop adding alcohol. Switch to water.
social.safety_transportation: Do not drive. Use a rideshare, designated driver, or other safe transportation.
social.safety_moderate_body: Coordination and judgment are reduced. Arrange a ride before you need one.
social.safety_high_body: Impairment risk is rising. Do not drive.
social.safety_critical_body: Impairment risk is rising. Do not drive.
social.not_legal_medical: BAC and impairment estimates are approximate only and must never be used to determine whether you are safe or legal to drive. If you have been drinking, do not drive. Use a rideshare, designated driver, or other safe transportation.
social.recovery_paywall_blurb: Recovery+ unlocks a personalized post-session plan with a morning estimate, hydration steps, and RTD pacing.

page1.title: A real-time human performance OS.
page1.body: AForce tells you what to do next, not what you did yesterday. The Pulse, score, and AI command update live.

page2.title: Home → Check → Protocol → Profile.
page2.body: Home shows your live score. Check updates your signals. Protocol shows the active stage. Profile is your settings + Demo Access.

page3.title: Unlock Phase 2 and Phase 3.
page3.body: Open Profile → DEMO ACCESS → Unlock all to preview Clutch (Command the Team) and Guardian (Protect the Roster).
